mapper.select: SELECT AVG(Rating) FROM reviews WHERE AcceptorID = #{userId}

SELECT r.ReviewID AS reviewId, r.TaskID AS taskId, t.Description AS taskDescription, r.ReviewerID AS reviewerId, u.Username AS reviewerName, r.Rating AS rating, r.COMMENT AS comment FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN users u ON r.ReviewerID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN task t ON r.TaskID = t.TaskID WHERE r.AcceptorID = #{userId} ORDER BY r.ReviewID DESC LIMIT 50
